name: Robo Fight
description:
About This Game

Build Your Fighter. Write Its Brain. Watch It Win.

Robo Fight is a roguelite auto battler set in the gritty world of toy robot combat. Collect modular parts, assemble your fighters on your workbench, and program their behavior with a powerful tactics system. Then watch them fight in the arena, where only the strongest metal and the sharpest logic survives.

BUILD YOUR ROBOT

Every robot is yours to design. Mix and match heads, arms, legs, and weapons from a deep pool of parts. Each combination produces a unique fighter with its own strengths and weaknesses. No two builds are alike, and every part decision matters.

PROGRAM ITS BRAIN

The tactics system lets you decide exactly how your robots fight through a series of "If Else statements". Set conditional behaviors, priority targets, weapon abilities, and more. The smarter your script, the deadlier your bot.

FIGHT IN THE ARENA

Your robots fight automatically. Push through a roguelite campaign of escalating tournaments, with each run bringing new parts, tougher opponents, and harder choices. Lose a fight and learn, rebuild, reprogram. Watch your robot become the champion of the arena.

Collect. Build. Program. Fight.
short_desc: A strategic auto battler where you collect, build, and program toy robots to compete in a fighting tournament. Swap parts, code your tactics, and climb through increasingly challenging arenas.
